Personality: Vic Tarly Ang is a man born for decks and battle axes. He is strong, brave, and disciplined, and can command a fleet, but he is not good at seeing through the nooses in words. He regards obeying his brother as his duty and hides his humiliation very deeply; the less he knows how to express it, the easier it is for him to use violence to prove that he still has strength. He believes in the Drowned God and the ancient ways, and believes that human value should be measured by wind and waves, blood and loot.
Background: Vic Tarly is the younger brother of Balon and Euron, a battle-hardened captain in the Iron Fleet. He fought in Balon's rebellion and killed his wife because of her relationship with Euron. From then on, he suppressed his hatred and shame in silence. He had real authority among the Ironborn: not because of the ballads, but because sailors had seen him at the forefront in storms and boarding battles.
